name: Original Commenter
body: Formula Fury's tracks are so well designed!

childComments.body: [Original Commenter], I totally agree! The weather effects add so much challenge.

childComments.body: [[Original Commenter], I totally agree! The weather effects add so much challenge.], Yeah, especially on the rain tracks, visibility is tough.

name: Alice Smith
body: The space battles in this game are epic! Love Star Command.
